events.summary: The Phyrexians are given the ability to move between planes, shown in a hook at the end of Kaldheim with Vorinclex's surprise appearance.
events.quote: This ability was shown in a brief hook at the end of Kaldheim with the surprise appearance of Vorinclex

events.summary: Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty acts as a prologue with Tamiyo's compleation.
events.quote: Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty acting as a prologue with Tamiyo 's compleation

events.summary: The arc's main story runs through Dominaria United, The Brothers' War, Phyrexia: All Will Be One and March of the Machine, with The Aftermath as epilogue.
events.quote: The arc comprised the main story of four expansion sets released from September 2022 until April 2023

events.summary: The story moves directly into the Omenpath Arc, showing the consequences of the New Phyrexian Invasion across the Multiverse.
events.quote: Afterwards, the story moved directly into the Omenpath Arc

relations.quote: The Phyrexian Arc is the storyline of the New Phyrexian Invasion .

relations.note: Followed it as the third major Planeswalker arc
relations.quote: It was Magic's third major Planeswalker arc after the Bolas Arc .
